correctness.rationale: The exact map u↦x in F2[A] gives u◦u=x* x² by expanding coefficients; x(1-xx*)=0 decomposes in the product of fields because |A| is odd. Fixed nontrivial inversion-stable Frobenius orbits yield norm-one kernel 2^(d/2)+1 plus zero, pairs yield 2^d choices. The trivial component gives two choices. Independent exhaustive coefficient-vector tests match every cyclic odd n up to 15 and C3×C3.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete all-odd-order abelian classification of binary Takasaki quandle algebra idempotents, giving independently selectable spectral norm-one structures and multiplicative exact counts beyond small tables or integer rigidity. Distinct examples (orders 5, 7, 9, 11, 15) demonstrate nontrivial reciprocity-controlled arithmetic; the noncyclic exponent-three family supplies a geometric boundary. No speculative downstream theorem is necessary.
